brief: A caddy to carry my bottle of bleach and a scrub brush around the house.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full joined with side connectors; piece:0,0,1;full + piece:0,1,1;full upper storey; bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full + bin:0,1,1~hex-bin-full two deep compartments
requirements.requirement: Caddy to carry around the house (joined multi-cell tote)

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full deep full-depth bin holds a tall bottle; no bleach-bottle prop exists in catalog so purpose could not be staged
bin:0,1,1~hex-bin-full second deep bin for brush; no scrub-brush prop exists (only paint brush prop) so purpose could not be staged
Parts are 3D printed in user-chosen material; configurator does not check chemical / bleach resistance, strength or load rating

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell base joined with side connectors with a 2-cell upper storey holding two deep full bins as caddy compartments for bottle and brush. No handle was fitted and no bleach or scrub-brush props exist to stage the purpose. Chemical resistance and carry-load safety are unverified.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
